outcome: Changes in human milk protein concentration over time
cohort: 105 lactating women and their full-term infants from China
finding: The concentration of proteins in human milk decreased over the first six months postpartum, with potential influence from maternal demographic and delivery factors, and α(s-1) casein concentration was inversely associated with infant weight-for-age Z-scores.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery impacted the longitudinal changes in milk proteins.
